create_task: create a Task instance with an agent and optional task_data dictionary for memory registration
create_controlblock: create a ControlBlock to manage a sequence of task generators with init and terminate conditions
bundle_task_list: bundle a list of tasks into a single task generator using maybe_bundle_task_list utility
wrap_task_to_generator: wrap a Task into a callable generator using task_to_generator for deferred execution
create_movement_task: create a BaseMovementTask subclass that changes agent location with a target location in task_data
